$comment: Runtime surface manifest (LLP 0010#runtime-command-surface; upstream LLP 0175 §8.1a in exact) — the single authority for the ibex command surface, kept next to the clap tree it pins. visibleCommands appear in `ibex --help` and must work standalone. hiddenHarnessCommands are compiled in but hidden from help (`self-test` is a CI harness smoke, not a user test runner; `compat` is the WPT/exact compat harness ported from exact-cli, ENG-23081 — its fixture tree lives in the exact repo). reservedCommands are runtime-namespace names with no implementation yet, and legacyProjectCommands are Exact project commands; both classes must be ABSENT from the clap tree entirely — the pre-clap dispatcher in src/bin/ibex/main.rs owns them and errors with a pointer. clapSurface is the exact recursive route/value-shape inventory plus the reviewed parser kinds and argument-conflict relations described there. replSurface and keybindingSurface are the generated authorities for REPL dispatch, help, completion, source-submission behavior, and Ibex-owned editor controls. Pinned in-process by cli.rs::surface_manifest_matches_clap_tree and the REPL surface generator; exact-side behavior guards read their own stale copy until retargeted here.

clapSurface.$comment: Every authored Clap command path joins exactly once to this recursive inventory. Authorship is captured before Command.build(): framework-generated help/version arguments and the generated help subcommand are excluded, while authored Help/Version actions and an authored help subcommand remain inventory entries. Positionals are included; an unbounded positional that accepts hyphen-prefixed values is classified as passthrough. Commands and options are sorted deterministically. Each argument records action, arity, requiredness, value names and domain, enum values and aliases, defaults, default-missing values, hyphen handling, and a true global marker when one root-authored option is reachable after subcommands; inherited child copies are not duplicate authored rows. maxValues null means unbounded. semanticRelations additionally records every reflected argument conflict and a stable reviewed parser kind for each non-enumerated value. Clap source attributes are fail-closed against an explicit reviewed key set so an unrepresented parser relation cannot appear silently. This is an exact contract for those recorded semantics, not a claim that help text and every internal Clap setting are serialized.

replSurface.$comment: LLP 0022 §8's exhaustive v1 dot-command contract. Dispatch, help, command completion, argument validation, source-ordinal behavior, and .load extension selection are generated from this section.

keybindingSurface.$comment: LLP 0025 §5's exhaustive published Ibex-owned session controls. The editor's ordinary Emacs editing profile is separate; these rows are the controls generated into .help and the session byte dispatcher.
